description: CircuitSetupRequest canonical CBOR encoding (Initiator → Relay). Encoded as an integer-keyed CBOR map: { 1: routeId, 2: hopIndex, 3: initiatorX25519PublicKey, 4: setupNonce }. The signing payload is prefixed by the SHARENET/CIRCUIT/SETUP/1 domain tag. The route MUST be a genuine BrandedCommittedRoute (WeakSet-verified by handleCircuitSetup); only the routeId is encoded — the full route is conveyed out-of-band.

constants.bodyEncoding: canonical CBOR (RFC 8949 §4.2.2), integer-keyed map per ADR-0004

sharedKeys.note: The BrandedCommittedRoute was produced by makeGenuineBrandedRoute (tests/helpers/branded-route-helper) which runs the full proof-carrying pipeline: advertisement verification → 3-message handshake → AuthenticatedLink → ValidatedHop → RouteAcceptance signatures → createRouteCommitment → createBrandedCommittedRoute. The X25519 key and setup nonce are fixed test values for byte-stable encoding.

vectors.name: valid-setup-request
vectors.description: Build a CircuitSetupRequest from a genuine BrandedCommittedRoute, encode via encodeCircuitSetupRequest, capture the canonical CBOR hex. Also compute circuitSetupSigningPayload (domain-prefixed) and capture its hex.

vectors.name: tampered-hopindex
vectors.description: Change hopIndex from 0 to 1. The canonical encoded bytes differ (the CBOR integer in map slot 2 changes), so the encoding is NOT byte-stable across mutations. A relay verifying the setup request against its expected hopIndex MUST reject. The signing payload likewise differs.

expected.encodingResult: ok (still valid CBOR, but different bytes)

notes: The BrandedCommittedRoute is NOT serialized inside the CircuitSetupRequest encoding — only its routeId is. The full route is conveyed out-of-band and verified at the relay via isBrandedCommittedRoute (WeakSet). This prevents a forged route object from being substituted at the wire layer. To re-encode at the verifier side, construct a CircuitSetupRequest with a minimal stand-in for route that has only the routeId field (encodeCircuitSetupRequest reads req.route.routeId only).
